sources.title: From Nucleons to Nucleus: Concepts of Microscopic Nuclear Theory
sources.author: Jouni Suhonen
sources.path: raw/books/From nucleons to nucleus concepts of microscopic .pdf

study_focus: Racah algebra, irreducible spherical tensors, 6j and 9j recoupling symbols, and Edmonds-Bohr-Mottelson phase conventions
microscopic electromagnetic transition operators, effective charges, and single-particle reduced matrix elements
surface delta interaction (SDI) and analytical antisymmetrized two-particle matrix elements
BCS pairing mean field, Bogoliubov-Valatin quasiparticle transformation, gap equation, and occupation numbers
quasiparticle random phase approximation (QRPA), X and Y amplitudes, and two-phonon collective vibrations
proton-neutron QRPA (pnQRPA), Gamow-Teller matrix elements, and the exact Ikeda sum rule S_- - S_+ = 3(N-Z)
evidence_boundary: AI-generated skill extraction and cross-linking; chapter locators are study navigation aids and do not replace page-level human review for publication claims.
